changes.reason: The reported fire occurred while Emperor Wu was alive (Jinshu 53, s0006–s0007); Jinshu 3 places his death in Taixi 1, fourth lunar month, conventionally AD 290. This is a latest possible Western year, not the fire year, and makes no lower-bound assertion. Sources: https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/晉書/卷053 ; https://zh.wikisource.org/wiki/晉書/卷003 ; https://ctext.org/datawiki.pl?if=en&res=637909 .
